name: Bounded Continuation Persistence Restricted-Domain Lemma Candidate
restricted_domain_conditions: I_continuity remains within bounded continuity class
counterexamples remain active outside restricted scope

candidate_statement.informal: Within a bounded local admissibility domain, continuation persistence may be locally maintained when admissibility cost remains within local budget, topology accessibility remains non-severed, reconstruction divergence remains bounded, and identity is treated only as bounded continuity-class behavior.
candidate_statement.formal: Persistence(alpha) is admissible iff C_A(alpha) <= B_local(alpha) and Reach(alpha, beta) is true and Divergence(Xi) is bounded.
